messages:
maria: Pager triggered — auth-proxy alert. High volume of session header echoes in logs (us-east-1). Possible PII leaking. Paging @ashwin (oncall).
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-487 created · severity=P1 · runbook=/runbooks/auth-logging-exposure
ashwin: I'm on it, joining bridge now. ETA 5m. Post any quick indicators here.
tracy: saw same pattern in us-west staging earlier — debug dump contained full header map. sample: `... \"x-session-id\": \"s-abc123\", \"user-email\": \"foo@example.com\" ...`
jeff: rollback/changes: we rolled a proxy config at 02:12 with debug_log_headers=true in canary. suspect flag caused serializer to include headers in debug dumps.
elaine: we should immediately disable header debug in prod and stop any log forwards to partners.
ashwin: running ssm command to toggle flag across hosts now:
```
aws ssm send-command --document-name \"ProxyToggle\" --parameters '{"debug_log_headers":["false"]}' --targets \"Key=tag:role,Values=proxy\"
```
deploy-bot: Command sent to 220 targets, 8 failures (retrying).
maria: Legal, include — need advice on disclosure if PII found. @legal please advise.
legal: Start by scoping: how many unique users, any email/phone/national-id present, and whether logs left external sinks. If >0 emails -> use customer-notify template A. If EU subjects -> DPO loop.
tracy: quick grep on quarantined logs: ~1.2k unique session ids, ~24 lines with email-like patterns, no SSNs detected in cursory scan. Some entries forwarded to partner log bucket between 02:14-02:18.
jeff: mitigation plan: 1) disable debug flag (in progress) 2) block/disable log forwarding to external sinks 3) snapshot/quarantine affected log objects 4) rotate service credentials used by shipper 5) notify CS/legal if PII confirmed
ashwin: debug flag disabled on 212/220 hosts, blocking forwarders now. Will retry the 8 failures.
maria: Jeff — please take lead on key rotation for the log-shipper credentials and confirm rotated keys are used by new agents only.
jeff: Created rotation job s3-key-rot-218765. KMS policy updated, initiating rotate and revoke of old key.
elaine: I paused external drains and pushed retention change to restrict access to quarantined logs. Also flagged partner integrations to hold ingest.
tracy: customer impact: backend auth flows unaffected. Impact limited to logs exposure window ~02:12–02:20. Potential small subset of user emails surfaced to partner buckets.
maria: CS: prepare holding statement and triage template. Ashwin please coordinate who to notify and the cadence for updates.
ashwin: Opening support bridge now and pinging CS leads. Bridge link: https://bridge.internal/INC-2026-487
deploy-bot: Severity lowered to P2 after mitigation actions completed and external forwarding blocked. Monitoring continues.
legal: collect the full list of affected customers and log object IDs. If any EU data, escalate to DPO immediately.
maria: preliminary root cause: debug flag accidentally enabled in canary promotion step — missing check in release pipeline to prevent debug flags in prod. Next actions: pipeline guard, add automated diff check forbidding sensitive debug flags, postmortem.
ashwin: adding runbook notes and action items to incident doc. Handoff to morning oncall @jeff in ~6h for follow-up and verification.
jeff: I'll verify rotated keys, ensure quarantined logs are scrubbed/erased where necessary, and open a JIRA for long-term pipeline fix (INC-2026-487).
maria: thanks everyone. Keep updates in this thread and incident doc. :white_check_mark:
